---
title: "Mickaël CANOUIL<span class=\"title-suffix\">, Ph.D.</span>"
subtitle: Biostatistician, Quarto wizard, and cinephile.
description: "Senior biostatistician at Alsinova and freelance developer in the Quarto and R ecosystems, pairing genetics and multi-omics analysis with open-source tooling."
image: /assets/images/og-image.png
image-alt: "Social preview card for mickael.canouil.fr: a gold MC monogram above the Mickaël CANOUIL wordmark, over a near-black background."
body-classes: home-page
format:
  mickaelcanouilfr-html:
    grid:
      body-width: 800px
    # Quarto's own obfuscation HTML-escapes the whole anchor and would print
    # the `iconify-icon` tag of the mailto buttons as literal text.
    # `filters/email-obfuscation.lua` covers the document links instead, and
    # the `about` block carries its own encoded href.
    email-obfuscation: none
listing:
  - id: home-featured
    contents:
      - projects/projects.yml
    template: assets/listing-templates/home-featured.ejs.md
    sort: "date desc"
    max-description-length: 160
    categories: false
    sort-ui: false
    filter-ui: false
    fields: [image, title, description, featured]
    # The template keeps three cards, but pagination counts the whole feed and
    # would render a pager below them; one large page removes it.
    page-size: 1000
  - id: home-posts
    contents: posts
    template: assets/listing-templates/blog.ejs.md
    sort: "date desc"
    max-items: 3
    max-description-length: 220
    categories: false
    sort-ui: false
    filter-ui: false
    feed: false
  - id: home-publications
    contents:
      - publications/publications.yml
    template: assets/listing-templates/home-publications.ejs.md
    sort: "issued desc"
    categories: false
    sort-ui: false
    filter-ui: false
    page-size: 1000
about:
  id: edu-exp
  template: solana
  image: /assets/images/profile.png
  image-width: 9em
  image-shape: round
  image-alt: "Profile picture of Mickaël CANOUIL"
  image-title: "Mickaël CANOUIL"
  links:
    # `pro@mickael.canouil.dev`, base64 behind the `#mc-email-` marker that
    # `assets/scripts/email.html` turns back into a `mailto:` on load. Quarto
    # builds the `about` block from this metadata before the Lua pipeline runs,
    # so `filters/email-obfuscation.lua` cannot reach it and a plain `mailto:`
    # here would ship the address for harvesters to read.
    - text: '{{< iconify octicon:mail-16 title="Contact" label="Envelope logo opening an email to Mickaël CANOUIL" >}}'
      href: "#mc-email-cHJvQG1pY2thZWwuY2Fub3VpbC5kZXY="
      aria-label: "Contact"
    - text: '{{< iconify fa7-brands:orcid title="ORCID" label="ORCID logo linking to Mickaël CANOUIL ORCID account" >}}'
      href: "https://orcid.org/0000-0002-3396-4549"
      aria-label: "ORCID"
      target: _blank
      rel: noopener noreferrer
    - text: '{{< iconify fa7-brands:bluesky title="BlueSky" label="BlueSky logo linking to mickael.canouil.fr account" >}}'
      href: "https://bsky.app/profile/mickael.canouil.fr"
      aria-label: "BlueSky"
      target: _blank
      rel: noopener noreferrer
    - text: '{{< iconify fa7-brands:linkedin title="LinkedIn" label="LinkedIn logo linking to mickaelcanouil account" >}}'
      href: "https://www.linkedin.com/in/mickaelcanouil"
      aria-label: "LinkedIn"
      target: _blank
      rel: noopener noreferrer
    - text: '{{< iconify fa7-brands:mastodon title="Mastodon" label="Mastodon logo linking to MickaelCanouil Fosstodon account" >}}'
      href: "https://fosstodon.org/@MickaelCanouil"
      aria-label: "Mastodon"
      rel: me noopener noreferrer
      target: _blank
    - text: '{{< iconify octicon:mark-github-16 title="GitHub" label="GitHub logo linking to mcanouil account" >}}'
      href: "https://github.com/mcanouil"
      aria-label: "GitHub"
      target: _blank
      rel: noopener noreferrer
    - text: '{{< iconify octicon:heart-fill-16 aria-hidden=true >}} Sponsor'
      href: "https://github.com/sponsors/mcanouil?o=esb"
      aria-label: "GitHub Sponsor"
      target: _blank
      rel: noopener noreferrer
---
